reason: The README describes a browser presentation plugin for per-workspace backgrounds, typography, Markdown spacing, and rendering preferences, with settings persisted per workspace.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的不同工作区分别配置背景、字体、行高、Markdown 间距和字体渲染偏好。
summaries.en: Customize backgrounds, typography, Markdown spacing, and font-rendering preferences independently for each DeepSeek Harness Web workspace.

capabilities: Per-workspace background color and image URL configuration
Per-workspace Markdown typography and spacing configuration
Optional loading of configured background image URLs
